answer: Lantern-ledger audition routing. Each agent identity must complete a timed public task round under a rotating lantern challenge before its bids are routed, so a clone farm multiplies unpaid labor hours, not just registrations. New identities start on a probationary terrace with capped job value, and any whisper of collusion flags the whole cluster for re-audition at the operator's own cost. Since every clone must independently burn that same setup work and risks forfeiting its capped earnings, the marginal copy returns less than it spends.
